name: downvid
description: 现代化的开源跨平台视频下载工具 — 一键保存全网无水印高清视频 / A modern, cross-platform open-source video downloader GUI
author: DownVid <downvid@example.com>

scripts.build: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:mac: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:win: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:linux: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:mac:arm64: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:mac:x64: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:linux:x64: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:linux:x64:appimage: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:linux:x64:deb: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:linux:x64:rpm: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux rpm --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.build:linux:x64:tar.gz: vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json5
